payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate i from 0 to n, compute energy as L*prefix_sum[i] + R*(total-prefix_sum[i]) plus extra cost if one arm does more consecutive picks; take min.
payload.rationale: Evaluates all possible split points i, making it a complete search. The code lacks backtracking recursion but enumerates all possibilities; given subtypes, search_backtracking is the closest fit among complete_search options.
